title: Branch protection, merge policy, and native secret scanning on main
summary: Owner configures the repository so that main takes changes only through a PR with every required CI check green, secret scanning with push protection is on, and history is protected (no force-push, no deletion). Per AUTH #007 a per-PR Code Owner review is NOT required to merge; independent review is periodic (the Coordinator's secondary review). The Builder's merge identity has write/merge access; no agent merges on red CI.

acceptance_tests.test: main is protected: force-pushes and deletions are blocked, and the required status checks apply to pull requests; administrators remain exempt, so direct pushes by the Owner's admin credential remain possible (Owner decision 2026-09-26).

Required status checks that must be green to merge: `lint gate`, `gitleaks`, `repo hygiene (env files, keys, raw media, size)`, `tickets validate`, `movement.json single source of truth`, `protected paths need APPROVED`, and `unity tests gate`. `android build gate` is excluded because android-build runs only on demand and would leave PRs stuck waiting (Owner decision 2026-09-26).

Per-PR Code Owner review is NOT required (AUTH #007); independent secondary review is a periodic process control, not a branch-protection gate. Stale-approval dismissal and linear-history settings are the Owner's choice.
Secret scanning and push protection are enabled (free on a public repository).
The Builder's merge identity can merge on green CI; a merge attempt with a red required check is rejected.

revised for AUTH #007: per-PR Code Owner review dropped; merge gated on green CI plus periodic secondary review; Builder merges on green CI

Owner API configuration verified: secret scanning and push protection are enabled; main requires the lint gate (strict=false), blocks force-pushes and deletions, and has no required PR reviews. The Owner chose admins-exempt protection (enforce_admins=false) on 2026-09-26 so direct pushes remain possible; AT-1 and AT-2 therefore differ from the ticket (PR-only main and the full required-check list), so status is in-review pending acceptance-policy reconciliation.

Owner decision at 1:23 PM CT applied: AT-1 now records protected main with force-push/deletion blocks, PR checks, and admins exempt for the Owner's direct pushes; AT-2 now records the seven configured required checks and explicitly excludes android build gate because it is on-demand. API readback is recorded in qa/vm-setup/repo-settings.md; secret scanning and push protection remain enabled. All required criteria are met, so the ticket is done.
